summary: Requirements cover price_order, discount, validation, receipt and pricer injection from the request. Acceptance criteria are concrete with boundary values (49999/50000/50009, qty 0, price -1/0). Two minor gaps: REQ-005 has no acceptance criteria and the order input structure for render_receipt is not stated.

checklist.item: Every part of the request covered
checklist.note: pricing, receipt, fake pricer injection, integration in tests/integration/ all in REQ-001..005; 'P4 only' is a process scope
REQ-004 order structure not defined explicitly (minor F-2)
ASM-001..003 cover return format, empty list, text format

findings.description: REQ-005 (constraint) has no acceptance criteria; add measurable ones, e.g. render_receipt works with a fake pricer without importing pricing, and default pricer is price_order.
The shape of the 'order' argument of render_receipt (order_id, lines keys sku/unit_price/qty) is implied only by AC-004-1; state it as an assumption.
